title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 SAI Branding is an innovation\-focused advertising and performance marketing agency dedicated to building impactful brands. With over 13 years of experience, SAI has successfully delivered more than 500 real estate projects and partnered with over 200 real estate groups. The agency combines strategic thinking with creative execution to help clients achieve measurable marketing results. Team members at SAI collaborate in a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment with exposure to diverse campaigns and brand challenges.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Graphic Designer role based in Gandhinagar. The Graphic Designer will create visual concepts and design assets for branding, advertising campaigns, social media, and digital and print materials. Responsibilities include developing logos and brand identities, selecting and arranging typography, and producing graphics that align with client objectives and SAI’s creative standards. The role involves collaborating closely with marketing and account teams, refining designs based on feedback, preparing files for production, and ensuring consistency across all visual touchpoints. The designer will also contribute ideas to creative brainstorming sessions and stay current with industry trends and design best practices.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Graphics and Graphic Design, with the ability to turn concepts into clear visual communication.
* Proficiency in Logo Design and Branding to develop coherent brand identities and campaign visuals.
* Solid understanding of Typography and its use in creating readable, attractive layouts.
* Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, or similar software).
* Portfolio demonstrating creative thinking, attention to detail, and experience across digital and print media.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gandhinagar, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Relevant education in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Knowledge of advertising and performance marketing concepts is an advantage, especially for real estate and brand\-building projects.

title: Website Designer (WordPress / Webflow / Framer)
description:
Idea to Edit is a creative and production agency working with brands in the US and India, from automotive and industrial companies to consumer brands. We handle strategy, production, advertising, and branding under one roof. The website is where all of that comes together, and we need someone to own it.
 



  





 You'll design, build, and manage websites for our clients and for ITE. You should know no\-code website building inside out across Webflow, Framer, and WordPress: layouts, CMS, interactions, responsive design, publishing, and fixing things when they break. You'll design it in Figma, build it yourself, and keep it running after launch.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design websites and landing pages in Figma
* Build and launch them in Webflow, Framer, or WordPress, depending on what the client needs
* Manage live sites: updates, new pages, CMS content, forms, and speed
* Set up on\-page SEO so our clients' sites actually get found
* Turn our video and photo work into pages that look premium



  





**Required** 



* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built yourself
* Strong Figma skills and a real eye for layout, type, and spacing
* Hands\-on experience building in Webflow, Framer, and WordPress (Elementor or a similar page builder)
* Basic HTML and CSS, enough for custom code, embeds, and small fixes
* Understanding of responsive design, site speed, and SEO basics



  





**Bonus** 



* JavaScript or custom code beyond the basics
* Motion or interaction work that makes a site feel alive
* Experience with integrations like forms, analytics, and email tools



 We don't care where you studied. We care about what you've built.
 



  





**What you get** 



* ₹37,000 to ₹45,000 per month, based on experience and portfolio
* Paid twice a month, on the 1st and 15th
* Real brands and international clients
* A small team where your work actually gets seen



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply here or email your resume and portfolio to info@ideatoedit.com. Include links to 2–3 live sites you built and tell us which parts you designed and which parts you built. Shortlisted candidates will get a short practical task.

title: Graphic Designer (Gujarati)
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 We are India's leading political consulting organisation, dedicated to providing high\-quality professional support for political campaigns. We strongly believe that the nation will best benefit from an enlightened political leadership in the form of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and are proud to have previously contributed in a similar capacity in the momentous election campaigns of 2014, 2019 and 2024, as well as various state elections.
 



  





 Our work includes envisioning and executing innovative electioneering campaigns, facilitating the capacity building of grassroots cadre, and shaping governance. We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results, not as an end in itself, but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India. Our work leverages on\-ground activities, data analytics, research, and new\-age media as force multipliers for the Prime Minister's messages and actions.
 



  





 We comprise a diverse group of dedicated individuals \- including former management consultants, lawyers, engineers, political theorists, public policy professionals, and experts from other varied sectors, all hailing from premier institutes and corporates \- with the unified objective of meaningfully contributing to the nation's polity.
 



  





**Position Requirements:**




 Candidate should be able to consistently create impactful communication collaterals across various mediums.
 



 Candidate will be expected to design creative in unison with copywriters in a fast\-paced work environment.
 



  





**Competencies:**




 \-1\-10 years of work experience in art/design vertical with an advertising agency (ATL/digital) or brand/start\-up
 



 \-Should have created posts/ads/banners for social media in previous role
 



 \-Ability to translate a brief into fine crafted communication collateral
 



 \-Candidates with proficiency in multiple languages will be preferred
 



 \-Candidate must have proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and CorelDraw
 



 \-A keen eye for aesthetics and details
 



 \-Ability to work methodically and meet deadlines
 



 \-Solid knowledge of design and visual principles
 



 \-Great multitasking skills and ability to work under pressure
 



 \-Proficiency in Gujarati, English \& Hindi is highly desirable
 



  





**Editing Machine/ Desktop is mandatory** 




**P.S This is a contractual role till Dec 2027**

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Location:** 

 Anand, Gujarat (On\-site)
 




**Job Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience Required:** 

 1–3 Years (Talented freshers with a killer portfolio are welcome)
 




**Reports To:** 

 Founder / Creative Head
 



**Job Overview** 


 We are looking for a highly creative
 
**Graphic Designer** 

 who lives and breathes visuals, typography, and colors. At The One Branding, we build identities for businesses. Your role will be to create powerful social media creatives, high\-converting carousels, and memorable brand identities that make our clients stand out in the market. If you can turn a simple brief into a visual masterpiece, you belong here.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Social Media Aesthetics** 
* Design high\-quality, engaging social media posts, reels layouts, covers, and interactive carousels for various industries (Real Estate, Retail, Automobile, D2C brands, etc.).
* Maintain a unique and consistent visual style (grid layouts, color themes) for each client's social media handle.


**2\. Core Branding \& Identity** 
* Create logos, corporate stationery, brand guidelines, and complete visual identities from scratch.
* Design premium print media assets like brochures, premium menus, product packaging, and outdoor hoarding banners.


**3\. Campaign Collaboration** 
* Work closely with the Content Writers and Copywriters to bring slogans and ad copies to life visually.
* Understand the client’s target audience and design visuals that actually bring results/leads for the client.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
* **Tools Mastery:** 

 Advanced skills in
 
**Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator** 

 . Working knowledge of
 
**Figma** 

 or Canva is preferred.
* **Design Eye:** 

 Strong command over color theory, modern typography, grid systems, and negative space.
* **Speed \& Creativity:** 

 Ability to deliver high\-quality concepts quickly without compromising on detailing.
* **Portfolio:** 

 A comprehensive portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, or Google Drive) showcasing social media campaigns and branding projects.
